import json
import subprocess
import sys

CANDIDATE = 'efa70b881f1d1884c7e69c5525a9430afc83214b'
TREE = 'bb734b95e4c77429312a9cb812157596d62efd5d'
PARENT = 'e9e4fa23c5bb672194a76237ba834e5d3188aab9'
BASE = '5c4d253c456ac8162fa4371341c7c52b7490fe45'
BRANCH = 'codex/sysgrid-smv1-protected-application-ci-verify-v25'

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True)

def git(*args):
    p = run(['git', *args])
    if p.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f'git {args}: {p.stderr.strip()}')
    return p.stdout.strip()

head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
tree = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD"'^{tree}'"')
parent = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD"'^'"')
branch = git('branch', '--show-current')
status = git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
main_local = git('rev-parse', 'refs/heads/main')
remote = run(['git', 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main'])
remote_main = remote.stdout.split()[0] if remote.returncode == 0 and remote.stdout.split() else None
if remote.returncode:
    remote_main = None

assert head == CANDIDATE, f'HEAD mismatch: {head}'
assert tree == TREE, f'tree mismatch: {tree}'
assert parent == PARENT, f'parent mismatch: {parent}'
assert branch == BRANCH, f'branch mismatch: {branch}'
assert not status, f'dirty worktree: {status}'

protection = run(['gh', 'api', 'repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/branches/main/protection'])
rulesets = run(['gh', 'api', 'repos/kimhw8084/sysgrid/rulesets?per_page=100'])
prot_state = 'unknown'
prot_summary = {}
if protection.returncode == 0:
    try:
        pdata = json.loads(protection.stdout)
        prot_state = 'true' if pdata else 'false'
        prot_summary = {
            'required_status_checks': pdata.get('required_status_checks'),
            'required_pull_request_reviews': bool(pdata.get('required_pull_request_reviews')),
            'enforce_admins': pdata.get('enforce_admins'),
            'allow_force_pushes': pdata.get('allow_force_pushes'),
        }
    except Exception:
        pass
elif 'HTTP 404' in protection.stderr or 'HTTP 404' in protection.stdout:
    prot_state = 'false'

ruleset_summary = []
if rulesets.returncode == 0:
    try:
        for item in json.loads(rulesets.stdout):
            conditions = item.get('conditions') or {}
            refs = conditions.get('ref_name') or {}
            includes = refs.get('include') or []
            excludes = refs.get('exclude') or []
            matches = ('~ALL' in includes or 'refs/heads/main' in includes or 'main' in includes) and not ('refs/heads/main' in excludes or 'main' in excludes)
            if matches:
                ruleset_summary.append({'name': item.get('name'), 'enforcement': item.get('enforcement'), 'target': item.get('target')})
                if item.get('enforcement') in ('active', 'evaluate') and prot_state == 'false':
                    prot_state = 'true'
    except Exception:
        pass

main_unchanged = main_local == BASE and remote_main == BASE
print(json.dumps({
    'branch': branch,
    'head': head,
    'tree': tree,
    'parent': parent,
    'worktree_clean': not status,
    'source_unchanged': head == CANDIDATE and not status,
    'main_local': main_local,
    'main_remote': remote_main,
    'main_unchanged': main_unchanged,
    'remote_r25_head': 'not queried; deferred to Fabric postprocessing',
    'live_branch_protection_observed': prot_state,
    'main_branch_protection_response': 'ok' if protection.returncode == 0 else protection.stderr.strip() or protection.stdout.strip(),
    'main_branch_protection_summary': prot_summary,
    'matching_main_rulesets': ruleset_summary,
    'rulesets_response': 'ok' if rulesets.returncode == 0 else rulesets.stderr.strip() or rulesets.stdout.strip(),
}, sort_keys=True))
if not main_unchanged:
    sys.exit(1)

    if p.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(p.stderr.strip())
    return p.stdout.strip()

    'head': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'),
